research_scope: Acquisition-path audit for the core CaC Awoken roster. Exact requirements are only promoted when supported; conflicting or version-sensitive claims remain qualified.

records.name: Super Saiyan
records.acquisition: Capsule Corporation Time Rift / Vegeta quest chain
records.exact_level: version/source conflict; do not canonicalize from older guides
records.notes: Current guide confirms the Capsule Corporation route but older sources disagree on the exact level gate.

records.name: Super Saiyan 2
records.acquisition: Continuation of the Capsule Corporation Saiyan transformation chain
records.notes: Do not split into a separate unrelated acquisition path.

records.name: Super Saiyan 3
records.acquisition: Continuation of the Capsule Corporation Saiyan transformation chain
records.notes: Do not infer a current level requirement from historical guides.

records.name: Super Vegeta
records.acquisition: Capsule Corporation / Vegeta progression after the Saiyan transformation chain
records.notes: Older sources report different level gates; retain the quest-chain requirement as canonical until a current game-state source establishes the exact gate.

records.name: Super Vegeta 2
records.notes: Same acquisition family as Super Vegeta.

records.name: Future Super Saiyan
records.acquisition: Complete the five Time Eggs and the associated Unknown History/Special Time Patrol story
records.notes: Independent historical sources agree on the Time Egg/Unknown History route; do not label this as a normal PQ reward.

records.name: Super Saiyan God
records.acquisition: Dragon Ball wish plus the required mentor/progression chain and associated battles
records.notes: Current sources disagree on the exact combination/order of friendship and quest requirements; retain the Dragon Ball-wish chain without inventing a precise threshold.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan
records.acquisition: Whis progression after Super Saiyan God
records.notes: Multiple sources converge on the high-level Whis route; exact friendship threshold should remain separately versioned.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan (Evolved)
records.notes: Current guides consistently place this after the Blue progression at a higher level; preserve the exact friendship requirement separately if unsupported.

records.name: Kaioken
records.acquisition: Parallel Quest 8 Ultimate Finish; defeat revived Goku for the chance at the skill
records.notes: The drop is RNG-based; no exact percentage is asserted.

records.name: Potential Unleashed
records.acquisition: Z-rank all standard Advancement Tests, then complete the unlocked Super Class/final Advancement Test
records.notes: Do not confuse the five-test prerequisite with the final test itself.

records.name: Beast
records.acquisition: Complete the required Gohan/Videl and Piccolo training/friendship progression and the Beast-awakening battle
records.notes: Current sources agree on the training route but differ in presentation of DLC/update prerequisites; preserve DLC provenance without inventing a single purchase requirement.

records.name: Ultra Instinct
records.acquisition: Jiren (Full Power) progression / associated late-game acquisition
records.notes: Current sources conflict on whether the skill is described through Jiren progression versus a specific late-game PQ/drop presentation. Preserve both source interpretations until the exact current acquisition screen is independently established.

records.name: Turn Golden
records.acquisition: Frieza's Spaceship Time Rift quest chain, culminating in the Frieza/Cooler progression
records.notes: Older sources cite Level 40 while newer summaries vary; the Spaceship chain is the stable acquisition fact.

records.name: Purification
records.acquisition: Majin Buu's House Time Rift / Buu-family quest progression
records.notes: The level-35 gate appears in established references, while the precise number of Buu children/progression steps is better treated as quest-state data.

records.name: Become Giant
records.acquisition: Guru's House Time Rift / Save Namek quest progression
records.notes: Independent sources converge on Guru's House and the Save Namek quest chain.

records.name: Power Pole Pro
records.notes: Dedicated current reference supports the level-35 gate and Great Saiyaman questline.

records.name: The Power to Overcome
records.notes: DLC ownership and story progression are established; the exact unlock checkpoint within Chapter 4 remains intentionally unresolved.
